result.description: A fictional high-capacity consumer solid-state drive built for everyday desktop and laptop storage upgrades. The Nova Meridian combines a compact M.2 2280 form factor with PCIe 4.0 x4 NVMe connectivity for fast boot times, responsive application launches, and quiet operation. It is positioned as a mainstream storage product rather than a workstation component, and it includes a simple thermal label and a limited 5-year warranty for budget-conscious builders.
